description: This file defines the Extender interface for Kubernetes scheduler extenders, including methods for filtering, prioritizing, binding, and preemption processing, as well as configuration checks.

classes.name: Extender
classes.description: Interface for external processes to influence Kubernetes scheduling decisions, including filtering, prioritizing, binding, and preemption support.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns a unique name identifying the extender.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters nodes based on extender-implemented predicate functions, returning filtered nodes and failure maps.

methods.name: Prioritize
methods.description: Calculates host priorities and weights for scheduling based on extender-implemented functions.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Delegates binding a pod to a node to the extender.

methods.name: IsBinder
methods.description: Indicates if the extender is configured for the Bind method.

methods.name: IsInterested
methods.description: Checks if the extender manages resources requested by the pod.

methods.name: IsPrioritizer
methods.description: Checks if the extender is configured for prioritization.

methods.name: IsFilter
methods.description: Checks if the extender is configured for filtering.

methods.name: ProcessPreemption
methods.description: Processes preemption, returning nodes with victim pods after extender intervention.

methods.name: SupportsPreemption
methods.description: Indicates if the extender supports preemption.

methods.name: IsIgnorable
methods.description: Indicates if scheduling should ignore the extender when unavailable.
